demos.name: Demo Map
demos.description: A one-page map of the demo family: a row for the Personal Agent demo, the Digital Worker agent and each Ping product, with the standalone apps that belong in it and the AI-DEMO2 pages for it. Mock uses a made-up sample; Real reads your local shelf.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7808). Docker: HOST_PORT=7808 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only; Mock only). Real: copy .env.example to .env, set AI_DEMO2_URL (SHELF_URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:4400) and run on the host. Rows are data/rows.json. No catalog row matches, so no catalogId; the owner assigns one with the board row.
